project_type: WFRP 4e character-sheet PWA — React 19 + TypeScript + Vite, CSS Modules, offline-first/local-only (no backend/network/LLM)
build_system: Vite 8 + project-reference tsc. QUIRK: package.json aliases `typescript` -> @typescript/typescript6 (for typescript-eslint's parser) and `@typescript/native` -> real typescript@7.0.2 (provides the `tsc` binary). So `npx tsc` runs TS 7.0.2. Do not change these aliases.
test_framework: Vitest 5 + @testing-library/react 16 + @testing-library/jest-dom + fast-check 4 (property tests) + jsdom. Tests live in __tests__/ dirs beside the code, named *.test.ts / *.test.tsx.
test_command: npx vitest --run  (or `npm test`); scope with a path, e.g. `npx vitest --run src/logic/guided-cast`
verification_instructions: ALL FOUR must be clean before a feature is done, run in d:\Git\PWACharSheet: (1) `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` exit 0; (2) `npm run build` succeeds; (3) `npx vitest --run` all pass (existing suites UNCHANGED + new suites green); (4) `npx eslint .` 0 errors and NO new warnings. Baseline at task start: tsc 0, eslint 0 errors / 3 pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components warnings (CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx). Do not add new warnings.
environment_constraints: Local worktree off a green base branch — no cloud sandbox, no env setup feature needed. No worktree isolation: implement directly on the current branch. Commit locally per feature; never push. The ONLY sanctioned `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` eslint-disable mirrors src/components/shared/Tooltip.tsx (also used in CombatPage.tsx, CollapsibleSection.tsx, etc.); reuse it ONLY if genuinely needed. Add NO other eslint-disable.
contribution_requirements: rules-compliance steering: every rulebook-derived rule carries a code-comment citation (Core p.234-239 / docs/windsofmagic.md; Errata overrides). Do NOT invent mechanics — all numbers come from src/logic/spell-casting.ts. calculated-totals steering: every displayed calculated total gets a breakdown tooltip via the shared Tooltip/TooltipTriggerCell with additive labelled lines (zeros shown). fix-errors steering: fix any error you encounter (incl. pre-existing) as part of the work; re-run the gate.
key_patterns: Guided Combat Turn is the exact precedent: pure reducer in src/logic/combat-turn/{types,reducer,steps}.ts with __tests__/{reducer.test.ts,reducer.property.test.ts,steps.test.ts}; portal overlay src/components/combat/GuidedTurnPanel.tsx (createPortal, role=dialog aria-modal, focus trap, Esc/backdrop close, stepper <ol> with aria-current, Arrow-key nav, live region, defaultTurnAdvisor sync-union); opt-in trigger GuidedTurnTrigger.tsx; step components src/components/combat/guidedTurnSteps/*. Advisor sync/async-union contract: src/logic/assistant/types.ts SuggestionSource (T | Promise<T>). Tooltip pattern: src/components/shared/Tooltip.tsx + TooltipTriggerCell.tsx (single-open index state: openTotalIndex + anchorEl; hover 300ms / tap / Enter-Space). SpellCastingPanel is rendered ONLY by CombatPage (`hasSpellcasting && <SpellCastingPanel character update updateCharacter addRoll />`) — but the design owns the guide reducer INSIDE SpellCastingPanel, so CombatPage needs NO edit.
